items.title: 63520_Ernie Fields oral history interview
items.q: So when Foots called me then about this Cab Calloway

ctx.x: Yes, talking about me. And all the others said yeah, that's okay, they all went for it.
So then that's where I had taken them over. So when Foots called me then about this Cab Calloway, he said it's going to be sensational, you better come on now, because he

said something about we're going east, they won't be trying to get anybody back this way after then and you'll be right in on the ground floor. I told Foots, well, no, I started with these little boys, but it might work up to something, Walt, and I believe I'll stick with it along with my little job for a while yet. So he said okay and went on and I turned that down. So we just played around and we would gig and so finally I got a gig up in--a guy by the name of Lloyd White--I forget how he got in touch with me…
